title: Compact Experience Bottles
description: Minecraft will introduce four new experience potion variants, each containing increased amounts of content: 4x, 16x, 64x, and 256x.
body:
This mod adds several new types of experience bottles to your game.

Here are all the types:
1. 🟢4x XP Bottle:
Crafted from four regular experience bottles
2. 🟢16x XP Bottle:
Crafted from four 4x XP bottles
3. 🟢64x XP Bottle:
Crafted from four 16x XP bottles
4. 🟢256 XP Bottle:
Crafted from four 64 XP bottles
(FOR DETAILED CRAFTS OF ALL POTIONS, SEE THE GALLERY SECTION)
